decisions.reason: The temporal definition records initial information in H_t, and the likelihood theorem permits a common nonempty initial history. With one prior event s<0 and alpha>0, the empty observed pattern has ratio e^T exp[-mu T-alpha exp(beta s)(1-exp(-beta T))/beta], whereas the original formula gave e^T exp(-mu T). Verification 1.3 also omitted alpha exp[-beta(t_i-s)] in every event factor. Retained the full conditional claim by including finite initial excitation c_0 in the intensity, event factors and integrated hazard; empty history sets c_0=0. This is a false likelihood under allowed histories, hence a fatal logic defect.
